nodes.line: Been here since before it was like this. Go on.

I have been putting it off since Easter. I am sending back 15 papers a day from Dulwich Hill and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

Before you say anything: yes, I know. They will drop my Dulwich Hill order if I can show $74 of turnover on the other side of the shop by the first of the month. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. That's it. That's the whole ask.
Take a breath. Then say the whole thing.

nodes.line: Do not mind the mess. It is structural now.

It is not a police matter and I have checked. I do the Dulwich Hill round from half six and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. There is a dog on the Dulwich Hill round that has had two of my bags and a esky of warm cans that was not even mine. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. If anyone asks, you were never here.
Go on then. What did you find.
